# BasicTools UK
> Free online tools for UK workers, freelancers, and small businesses. No sign-up. No data collection. All rates verified from GOV.UK.

## About
BasicTools UK provides free financial and business tools for people in the United Kingdom. Built by ScamShield UK (https://scamshield.org.uk). All tax rates and wage figures are sourced from GOV.UK and verified against the House of Commons Library as of 31 March 2026. This site does not provide financial advice.

## Tools

### UK Self-Employed Tax Calculator
Calculate Income Tax and National Insurance for self-employed workers in England, Wales, and Northern Ireland. Covers 2025/26 and 2026/27 tax years.
- Personal Allowance: 12,570 (tapers above 100,000)
- Basic rate: 20% on profits 12,570 to 50,270
- Higher rate: 40% on profits 50,270 to 125,140
- Additional rate: 45% on profits above 125,140
- Class 4 NIC: 6% main rate, 2% above 50,270
- Class 2 NIC voluntary: 3.50/week (2025/26), 3.65/week (2026/27)
- Source: https://www.gov.uk/income-tax-rates

### UK National Minimum Wage Checker
Check whether you are being paid at least the legal minimum wage. Includes underpayment calculator, April 2026 wage rise calculator, and historical rates from 2018 to 2026.

UK Minimum Wage Rates from April 2026:
- Age 21 and over (National Living Wage): 12.71/hour
- Age 18 to 20: 10.85/hour
- Age 16 to 17: 8.00/hour
- Apprentice rate: 8.00/hour
- Source: https://www.gov.uk/national-minimum-wage-rates
- ACAS helpline for underpayment: 0300 123 1100

### UK Invoice Generator
Create professional invoices with VAT for UK businesses. Supports multiple line items, adjustable VAT rate (0-25%), and print/PDF export. No account required.

### AI Scam Checker
Paste a suspicious text, email, or WhatsApp message to check if it is a scam. Hosted at https://scamshield.org.uk.

## Privacy
BasicTools UK does not collect, store, or transmit any personal data. All calculations run entirely in the user's browser. No cookies. No analytics. No data leaves the device.
